questions.q: Under standard Value Added Tax (VAT) regulations, all the following items are categorized as **exempt goods and services** EXCEPT
options: Commercial electronic equipment and home appliances
questions.explain:
**Exempt goods and services** are items on which no VAT is charged, typically to reduce the cost of living or encourage essential social services (e.g., basic raw foods, medical supplies, educational materials, and public transport). 

**Commercial electronics and home appliances** are standard taxable luxury/consumer goods and attract full VAT.
